title: Lakebase observability telemetry in system tables (Beta)
body: Lakebase captures its Postgres observability telemetry into the `system.lakebase` system tables, with no configuration to create and no destination to choose. Query plans, session history, wait events, schema-change history, database and compute health, and Postgres logs land there, and records are retained for 7 days. Account admins and metastore admins can read the tables and manage access to them, and a user with access queries the telemetry the way they would any Unity Catalog table. See [Lakebase telemetry in system tables](/aws/en/oltp/projects/observability-telemetry-reference).
